projection.model: Waymo camera calibration + image pose + Brown-Conrady 9 intrinsics; raw annotated 3D cuboid corners
projection.rolling_shutter: provided image pose approximation; no per-row rolling shutter or object-motion compensation
projection.drawing_visibility: raw projected_lidar_labels FRONT track whitelist; finite pinhole frustum before distortion
projection.coordinates: resized FRONT pixel top-left origin; camera x forward y left z up

lidar_contract.box_selection: 3D annotation OBB in frame vehicle coordinates; may contain ground/occluder points
lidar_contract.coordinates: per-frame actor local x forward y left z up
lidar_contract.aggregation: each measured row transformed with its own same-frame box pose; no learned completion
lidar_contract.motion_limit: TOP per-pixel ego-motion compensation only; within-scan actor motion is not compensated
lidar_contract.color_projection: finite pinhole frustum before Brown distortion; no visibility zbuffer; invalid colors gray
